text.p: The following stories were reported in Lithuanian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Lithuanian American Valdas Adamkus, a former high-ranking official with the Environmental Protection Agency, said that he will run in December's presidential contest provided.
- Police detained two armed suspects immediately after they robbed a branch of the Lithuanian Savings bank in Kaunas on Monday.
- A visa-free agreement between Lithuania and Finland might be signed in autumn, Finnish Interior Affairs Minister Jan Eric Enestam on said Tuesday.
- Lithuanian Gas started preliminary negotiations with Merrill Lynch over a $45 million credit to pay Russia's Gazprom for supplies.
- Lithuanian Prime Minister Gediminas Vagnorius said his family's net income last year was 32,240 litas.
- The Lithuanian Sea Shipping company sold a motor boat made 26 years ago for $ 404,000 to Germany's Albatros Shipping.

- The general shareholders' meeting of the Lithuania Hotel decided on Tuesday to pay 768,000 litas in dividends out of its 817,000 litas net profit in 1996. The net profit of the biggest hotel in the country has fallen steadily since 1993. The state-run hotel was included on the list of enterprises to be privatised by open bids in 1997-1998.
- The Lithuanian and Finnish interior affairs ministers signed agreements on crime prevention.
- Flemings investment bank intends to participate in the privatisation of strategic companies of Lithuania, Lithuanian Telecom in particular.
- Leading bank Vilniaus bank reported a 24.44 million litas net profit in 1996 and said its assets rose by 139 percent last year.
